cues.en: Now that we're done with the base templates, let's create an activation email template.
cues.zh: 基底範本完成後，建立啟用郵件範本。

cues.en: This template is going to be used to send an account activation email to the user when they register.
cues.zh: 使用者註冊後，會用這個範本寄送帳戶啟用郵件。

cues.en: As you can go back to our Project Explorer then still under templates we're going to create a new file.
cues.zh: 回到專案檔案總管，在 templates 裡新增檔案。

cues.en: This is going to be activation dot HTML.
Then within this template we're now going to see the power of template inheritance in ginger.
cues.zh: 這個範本會展示 Jinja 範本繼承的威力。

cues.en: So we can say here at the top for this particular template we're going to extend the base dot HTML template.
And so base dot HTML like that.
Then what do you want to extend.
We're going to change the title block.
So you can say block title like that then end block.
cues.zh: 寫 block title，再用 endblock 結束。

cues.en: And so for the title block for this email template we're going to say account activation like that.
cues.zh: 這個郵件範本的 title 是「帳戶啟用」。

cues.en: And so what this basically means is when this template is going to be rendered, we're going to look at the base dot HTML file.
cues.zh: 也就是範本呈現時，會查看 base.html，

cues.en: Then find out where we have the block title which is going to be right up here.
cues.zh: 找到 title 區塊，就在上方這裡，

cues.en: Then you're going to substitute this portion of the template with the text account activation.
cues.zh: 再用「帳戶啟用」替換這個部分。

cues.en: Then we're going to do the same for the header.
So you can see block header.
So the block header.
Then we can end block like that.
So our header for this template is going to be activate your account like that.
cues.zh: 這個範本的標題是「啟用你的帳戶」。

cues.en: Then after that we're going to define the block content like that.
And as you can see the beauty about template inheritance is we don't have to declare all these HTML structure and styling.
cues.zh: 範本繼承的優點，就是不用重寫所有 HTML 結構與樣式。

cues.en: Once this is done and we've added this particular blocks in our templates, we can now just substitute the different blocks with the specific text that we want rendered or the specific tags that we want
cues.zh: 只要先定義好，並在範本加入這些區塊，就能替換不同區塊，放入希望呈現的特定文字或

cues.en: rendered.
So for example, in this activation email template for the block content we're now going to have H2 tag.
cues.zh: 例如啟用郵件的 content 裡，放 h2。

cues.en: And here we can say welcome to.
Then I'm going to pass in the site name.
As part of the context to this template.
cues.zh: 作為這個範本的情境資料。

cues.en: You're going to see that much later.
Then we're going to have another paragraph tag.
And you can say thank you for registering with us.
Then you can say, please click the button below to activate your account like that, then we can now render the button with an anchor tag.
cues.zh: 再寫「請按下方按鈕啟用帳戶」，接著用 a 標籤呈現按鈕。

cues.en: Then you're going to have the href.
And within the href we're going to pass in the activation underscore URL like that.
Then you're going to style this button by saying the background color that's going to be for CA then
cues.zh: 再設定按鈕樣式，background-color 是 #4CA，

cues.en: F of 50, then the color that's going to be white, then the padding, the padding is going to be 14 pixels top bottom then 20 pixels left right.
cues.zh: 後面接 F50；color 是白色；padding 上下十四像素、左右二十像素。

cues.en: Then the text decoration that's going to be none.
And then the border radius that's going to be four pixels.
Then within the button we're going to render the text activate account just like that.
cues.zh: 按鈕顯示文字是「啟用帳戶」。

cues.en: Then after the anchor tag we're going to have a paragraph tag.
cues.zh: a 標籤後面加入段落。

cues.en: And you can say if the button does not work we can now say copy and paste the following link into your browser.

cues.en: Then after the paragraph tag we're going to have another div.
cues.zh: 段落後面再放一個 div。

Then you're going to say word brick.
The word brick is going to be brick.
All.
So the word brick.
Brick all basically means that the text will break at any character to avoid overflow of the text.
cues.zh: 設為 break-all，表示可在任何字元處換行，避免文字溢出。

cues.en: Then the background color, the background color is going to be bound, and five f5, f5, then padding.
That's going to be ten pixels.
Then the border radius that's going to be four pixels.
Then the margin margin is going to be ten pixels top bottom, zero pixels left right.
cues.zh: margin 上下十像素，左右零。

cues.en: Then the font family that's going to be monospace like that.
Then within the div tag we're going to pass in the activation URL just like that.
Then after the div we're going to have another paragraph tag, and you're going to say this link will expire in.

Then minutes just like that.

Activate your account.
